v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Dixit Dóminus * Dómino meo: Sede a dextris meis. ‡
text.en: The Lord said to my Lord: * Sit thou at my right hand. ‡

text.la: Magna ópera Dómini: * exquisíta in omnes voluntátes eius.
text.en: Great are the works of the Lord, * sought out according to all his wills.

text.la: Qui timet Dóminum, * in mandátis eius cupit nimis.
text.en: Blessed is the man that feareth the Lord; * he shall delight exceedingly in his commandments. ‡

text.la: Sit nomen Dómini * benedíctum in sǽcula.
text.en: Blessed be the name of the Lord * from henceforth now and for ever.

text.la: Deus autem noster * in cælo: ómnia quæcúmque vóluit, fecit.
text.en: But our God is in heaven, * he hath done all things whatsoever he would.

text.la: Fratres: Estóte imitatóres Dei, sicut fílii caríssimi: et ambuláte in dilectióne, sicut et Christus diléxit nos, et trádidit semetípsum pro nobis oblatiónem et hóstiam Deo in odórem suavitátis.
text.en: Be ye, therefore, followers of God, as most dear children; And walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, and hath delivered himself for us, an oblation and a sacrifice to God for an odour of sweetness.

v.la: Ángelis suis Deus mandávit de te.
v.en: God hath given His Angels charge over thee.

r.la: Ut custódiant te in ómnibus viis tuis.
r.en: To keep thee in all thy ways.

text.la: Extóllens vocem * quædam múlier de turba, dixit: Beátus venter qui te portávit, et úbera quæ suxísti. At Iesus ait illi: Quinímmo beáti, qui áudiunt verbum Dei, et custódiunt illud.
text.en: A certain woman of the company lifted up her voice and said: * Blessed is the womb that bare thee, and the paps which Thou hast sucked. But Jesus said unto her: Yea, rather, blessed are they that hear the word of God, and keep it.

text.la: Quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus, vota humílium réspice: atque ad defensiónem nostram, déxteram tuæ maiestátis exténde.
text.en: We beeseech thee, almighty God, look upon the hearty desires of thy humble servants, and stretch forth the right hand of thy Majesty to be our defense against all our enemies.
